sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
The project aims to improve the capability, resilience and performance of small businesses across New South Wales through accessible, practical and evidence-based advisory support.

It will help small businesses build core business skills, strengthen resilience, improve productivity and access trusted advice to support business sustainability and growth. The project will also provide targeted support for priority industries, customer cohorts and regional communities, while encouraging digital capability, innovation and the adoption of contemporary business tools and practices.

Through this procurement, Service NSW seeks to improve business outcomes, support economic participation and contribute to the long-term prosperity of communities across NSW.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
Service NSW is seeking responses from suitably qualified providers to deliver small business advisory services across New South Wales.

The program will provide free advisory and capability-building support to individuals seeking to start a business and existing small businesses looking to establish, sustain, adapt or grow their operations.

Services may include:

- one-to-one business advisory services delivered face-to-face, online and by telephone
- workshops, webinars and networking events
- digital learning resources and self-service tools
- business resilience, continuity and disaster recovery support.

Suppliers may bid for one or more of the following service types:

- Core Business Skills services for all small businesses
- Specialist advisory servicesfor:

  - construction businesses
  - hospitality businesses
  - women-owned businesses
  - multicultural-owned businesses.

Suppliers may bid to deliver services statewide and/or within one or more defined geographic service regions.

The procurement is intended to result in the engagement of multiple providers to deliver services from February 2027 to 30 June 2030, with extension options available.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
Interested suppliers should review all procurement documentation, including the Statement of Requirements, Conditions of Tender and Supplier Response Schedules.

Supplier Briefing

A non-mandatory supplier briefing will be held via Microsoft Teams at 10:00 am (AEST) on Tuesday 8 September 2026.

Suppliers wishing to attend must register by email to snsw9635@customerservice.nsw.gov.au prior to the briefing. Registration must include the supplier name, attendee names and attendee email addresses. A maximum of two representatives per supplier may attend.

Microsoft Teams access details will be provided to registered attendees prior to the briefing.

Following the briefing, Service NSW will publish an addendum containing any presentation materials and a consolidated record of questions and responses. Information provided during the briefing is for clarification purposes only and does not amend the Request for Tender unless confirmed by formal addendum.

All requests for clarification must be submitted in accordance with the Conditions of Tender.
